text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
From here on out, let us each prepare our 
recreation activities. 
Leave the coordination entirely to me.

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
All right--!! Let's show 'em what 
'exceeding expectations' is all about!! 
With enough momentum to stack a hundred 
loaves of bread vertically!!

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
Golshi-san! 
What are you preparing?

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: Tailor shop.

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
I'm sewing all kinds of stuff~ Reindeer, 
Santas, trees, you name it! 
We're gonna wear these and have a contest!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
What about you? Decided on what you wanna 
do yet?

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
No, I am still considering my options. 
I came to conduct an investigative inquiry 
on what everyone is planning.

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
Even with the goal of 'exceeding 
expectations'... 
it is proving rather difficult to 
determine the best course of action.

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Well, figures. You're basically a baguette 
by nature, 
so being told to suddenly turn soft and 
fluffy is a tall order.

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
All right! Guess Big Sis Golshi has gotta 
show you the way! 
Feel free to marvel at my high-speed 
hand-sewing technique as much as you like~

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
No, that is quite enough. Thank you for 
your cooperation.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
Hup, here we go. Ahhh, playing cards... 
got about three sets. 
Looks like I can use these instead of a 
roulette wheel...

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
Nakayama-san, is everything going 
smoothly? 
If there is anything you lack, I will 
handle all the arrangements.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
Ohh. I'm thinking of lining up a bunch of 
nail-biting games. 
I also wanna make some kind of food and 
drink, though.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
Ah, and tea leaves. Something along these 
lines.

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
...Understood. I shall arrange for the 
very finest selections. 
――As for Meno-san... you are still 
deliberating, correct?

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
I would like to tell you to take all the 
time you need to polish your ideas... but 
time is limited. 
If you run into any trouble, please do not 
hesitate to consult me.

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text: Orfe. Is there anything I can help with?

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text: Nay, it is unnecessary.

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
By the way, what are you writing at the 
moment?

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text: Imperial decrees.

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
Hehe. Is this something like a prompt box? 
May I take a look?

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
'Perform the Tracen Ondo entirely solo to 
the end.' 'Perform an impression of an 
object.'... 
Hehehe. Quite a diverse selection of 
challenges.

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
A mission-based game where one must act 
according to whichever decree they draw at 
random, I presume. 
Yes, this promises to be exceptionally 
lively.

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text:
Heh. This shall make the entertainment all 
the more fitting.

text_block_list.name: Miho Dorm Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
The Christmas party is coming up soon~! 
Isn't it true they're doing things totally 
different this year?

text_block_list.name: Miho Dorm Umamusume B
text_block_list.text:
Ah, yeah, fireworks went off out of 
nowhere earlier and Fenomeno-senpai was 
super mad, so I was wondering what would 
happen...

text_block_list.name: Miho Dorm Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
Right~? But somehow it looks like it's 
gonna turn out amazing. Word is it's gonna 
be a fancy party, so we should dress up a 
bit~!

text_block_list.name: Miho Dorm Umamusume B
text_block_list.text:
I know! Apparently Nakayama-san is 
preparing a bunch of games, and 
Golshi-senpai might be hosting a costume 
contest or something? Can't wait~!

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
How are things coming along, Meno-san? 
...Oh my. Are these Christmas presents?

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
Yes! I have finally decided on my plan. 
When it comes to Christmas, receiving a 
present is surely the most delightful 
moment of all.

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
Therefore, I thought delivering that joy 
to each and every participant would be the 
absolute best thing to do.

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
――Splendid. 
Is wrapping the only task remaining? If 
you'd like, allow me to lend a hand.

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text: ――! Yes, that would be a tremendous help!

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text: ――――I truly hope everyone will be happy...

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
Giggle. ――Let us make it a wonderful 
party.
